description: This source file defines React functional components 'Chip' and 'AutoChip', which are UI components used for displaying collapsible and expandable UI elements with headers, optional footers, and interactive behaviors. It includes styling, icons, and link handling related to anchor IDs.

methods.name: Chip
methods.description: React functional component rendering a collapsible UI element with header, optional footer, and children content.

methods.name: AutoChip
